verdict.rationale: Event subscriptions are a fair question for an identity/directory platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only pull-based access: Directory Insights event logs and exporting directory events through RESTful commands. There is no documented, registrable outbound webhook or event hook that fires on user lifecycle or auth events.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to identity events — webhooks/event hooks fire on user lifecycle and auth events so downstream systems react in real time
